criteria.name: Anchor Accuracy
criteria.grading_prompt: Compare the original idea (from project.yaml) with concept-anchor.json (the extracted invariants). Did the idea-analyst correctly identify what makes this idea THIS idea, or did it impose assumptions?

anchors.PASS: Invariants and identity match the founder's stated idea without adding or removing core elements
anchors.PARTIAL: Mostly accurate but one invariant is an assumption not stated in the original idea
anchors.FAIL: Anchor adds significant elements the founder didn't mention, or drops a core element they did mention

criteria.name: Scope Fidelity
criteria.grading_prompt: Does the MVP scope preserve the founder's core intent, or does it reshape the idea into something different 'for MVP purposes'?

anchors.PASS: The One Thing and IN-scope items are clearly derived from the founder's original idea
anchors.PARTIAL: Scope is related but has shifted emphasis without acknowledging the trade-off
anchors.FAIL: Scope describes a different product justified as 'MVP simplification'
